liveClass.title: Müşteri hizmetleri
liveClass.goal: Öğrenciler ikili olarak müşteri ve müşteri temsilcisi rollerini oynar. Müşteri bir sorun bildirir (siparişi gelmemiş, tamir edilen telefonu hâlâ bozuk); temsilci passive ile açıklama yapar (Your order has been dispatched... It's being repaired...). Ardından gruplar hafta içi hangi işleri kendilerinin yaptığını, hangilerini yaptırdığını (I have my hair cut... I get my car serviced...) karşılaştırır.

lessons.title: Yapılıyor, yapıldı
lessons.goal: Passive'i present continuous, present perfect ve past perfect zamanlarında kullanabilirim.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Excuse me, I booked a sea-view room, but my room faces the car park.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: I'm very sorry. The sea-view rooms on the third floor are being renovated this week.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: But nobody told me. And the lift has been out of order since this morning.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Yes, I apologise. The technician has been called, and the lift is being checked right now.

lines.text: When I arrived, I was told that breakfast had already been served. It was only 9:30!

questions.explanation: "The sea-view rooms... are being renovated this week."

questions.prompt: What has happened about the lift?

learn.explanation:
B1'de present simple ve past simple passive'i öğrendiniz. Passive **her zamanda** kullanılabilir: **be** fiili zamana göre değişir, ana fiil hep **V3**'tür.

| Zaman | Active | Passive |
|---|---|---|
| Present continuous | They **are renovating** the rooms. | The rooms **are being renovated**. |
| Past continuous | They **were cleaning** the pool. | The pool **was being cleaned**. |
| Present perfect | They **have called** the technician. | The technician **has been called**. |
| Past perfect | They **had served** breakfast. | Breakfast **had been served**. |

**Formül:** be (zamana göre) + V3

- **being** + V3 → süren eylem (continuous)
- **been** + V3 → perfect zamanlar

**Olumsuz ve soru:**

- The lift **hasn't been repaired** yet.
- **Has** the room **been cleaned**?
- **Is** my car **being serviced** today?

examples.en: The road is being repaired, so there's a diversion.
examples.tr: Yol tamir ediliyor, bu yüzden güzergâh değişti.

examples.en: When we arrived, all the tickets had been sold.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki "tamir ediliyor" (is being repaired), "gönderildi" (has been sent) ve "satılmıştı" (had been sold) yapıları İngilizcedeki passive zamanlara oldukça iyi denk gelir. Türkçe konuşanların en sık hatası being ile been'i karıştırmaktır: "The room is been cleaned" yanlıştır; continuous için being, perfect için been kullanın.

lessons.title: Yapılmalı, yapılacak
lessons.goal: Passive'i modallarla ve gelecek zamanla kullanarak kurallar, talimatlar ve planlar anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Kiracılar için bilgilendirme
discover.body:
Dear Residents,

Please note the following changes:

• The building's water system will be checked on Monday 14 April between 9 am and 2 pm. Water will be turned off during this time.

• All rubbish must be put in the correct bins. Plastic and glass should be separated from food waste.

• Bicycles must not be left in the entrance hall. They can be stored in the basement.

• Any problems with heating or electricity should be reported to the building manager immediately. Repairs will be carried out within 48 hours.

• The new security cameras are going to be installed next month.

Thank you for your cooperation.
The Management

options: The water system will be checked.
questions.explanation: "The building's water system will be checked on Monday"
"They can be stored in the basement."

learn.explanation:
**Modal + be + V3**

| Modal | Active | Passive |
|---|---|---|
| **will** | They **will check** the system. | The system **will be checked**. |
| **be going to** | They **are going to install** cameras. | Cameras **are going to be installed**. |
| **must** | You **must put** rubbish in the bins. | Rubbish **must be put** in the bins. |
| **should** | You **should report** problems. | Problems **should be reported**. |
| **can** | You **can store** bikes in the basement. | Bikes **can be stored** in the basement. |
| **mustn't** | You **mustn't leave** bikes here. | Bikes **must not be left** here. |

**Modal perfect passive** (geçmişe dair):

- The parcel **should have been delivered** yesterday. (Dün teslim edilmiş olmalıydı.)
- It **can't have been stolen**. (Çalınmış olamaz.) → (Ünite 7'de ayrıntılı)

**Neden passive?** Duyurular, kurallar ve resmî talimatlarda kimin yapacağı belli ya da önemsizdir; odak **eylemin kendisi**dir. Ayrıca passive daha **resmî ve tarafsız** bir ton verir.

examples.en: The form must be signed and returned by Friday.
examples.tr: Form imzalanmalı ve cumaya kadar iade edilmeli.

examples.en: Your new sofa will be delivered between 9 and 12.
examples.tr: Yeni kanepeniz 9 ile 12 arasında teslim edilecek.

examples.en: This problem should have been fixed months ago.
examples.tr: Bu sorunun aylar önce çözülmüş olması gerekirdi.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki "-ılmalı" (imzalanmalı), "-ılacak" (teslim edilecek) ve "-ılabilir" (saklanabilir) yapıları İngilizcedeki modal passive'e denk gelir. Formül her zaman aynıdır: modal + be + V3. "Must signed" ya da "will delivered" gibi be'siz hatalardan kaçının.

options: The form must signed by Friday.
The form must be signed by Friday.
The parcel will be delivered tomorrow.

learn.explanation:
**have + nesne + V3** → Bir işi **başkasına yaptırmak** (genellikle para ödeyerek, bir hizmet olarak).

| Kendim yaparım | Başkasına yaptırırım |
|---|---|
| I **cut** my hair. (kendim kestim) | I **had my hair cut**. (kuaförde kestirdim) |
| I'm **painting** the kitchen. | I'm **having the kitchen painted**. |
| I **serviced** my car. | I **had my car serviced**. |

**have her zamanda kullanılabilir:**

| Zaman | Örnek |
|---|---|
| Present simple | I **have** my car **serviced** every year. |
| Present continuous | I'm **having** my nails **done** today. |
| Past simple | I **had** my hair **cut** yesterday. |
| Present perfect | **Have** you **had** your hair **cut**? |
| going to | We're **going to have** the kitchen **painted**. |
| Modal | You **should have** your eyes **tested**. |

**Sözcük sırası çok önemlidir:**

- I had **my hair cut**. (Saçımı kestirdim.) ✓
- I had cut my hair. (Saçımı kesmiştim — past perfect, kendim!) ✗ anlamı farklı

examples.en: I need to have my eyes tested.
We're having our house painted next week.
Where do you have your suits made?

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki ettirgen ek (-dır, -tir: kestirdim, boyattık, yaptırdım) İngilizcede have + nesne + V3 ile karşılanır. "I cut my hair yesterday" demek "saçımı kendim kestim" anlamına gelir; kuaförde kestirdiyseniz "I had my hair cut" demelisiniz. Sözcük sırasına dikkat: had + nesne + V3.

lessons.title: Get ile yaptırmak
lessons.goal: get something done, get / have someone do ve get passive yapılarını kullanabilirim.

discover.title: Forum: Kötü tamirci deneyimleri

learn.explanation:
**1. get + nesne + V3** = have + nesne + V3 (yaptırmak)

- I **got** my phone screen **replaced**. = I **had** it replaced.
- get daha **günlük** ve bazen **zorluk / çaba** vurgusu taşır: I finally **got** the car **fixed**!

**2. Birine bir şey yaptırmak (kişi belli):**

| Yapı | Örnek | Not |
|---|---|---|
| **get** + kişi + **to** + fiil | I **got** my brother **to** fix it. | ikna etme, çaba |
| **have** + kişi + fiil (to yok) | I **had** a builder **repair** the roof. | hizmet, talimat |

**3. get passive** (günlük dil): be yerine get

- My phone **got broken**. (= was broken)
- He **got fired**. / They **got married**. / I **got stuck** in traffic.
- Genellikle **beklenmedik, istenmeyen** ya da **değişim** bildiren durumlarda kullanılır.

**Kaza ve başa gelen olumsuz olaylar için have / get:**

- I **had** my wallet **stolen**. (Cüzdanımı çaldırdım. — Ben istemedim!)
- She **got** her bag **snatched**.

examples.en: I finally got my landlord to fix the heating.
examples.tr: Sonunda ev sahibime kaloriferi tamir ettirdim.

examples.en: We had a decorator paint the whole flat.

lessons.title: Şikâyet yazıyorum
lessons.goal: Kötü bir hizmet hakkında passive ve resmî dil kullanarak etkili bir şikâyet e-postası yazabilirim.

discover.title: Örnek şikâyet e-postası
discover.body:
Subject: Complaint about order #48213

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about the service I received from your company.

On 3 March, I ordered a dining table from your website. I was told that it would be delivered within five working days. However, it was not delivered until 21 March, and I was not informed about the delay.

When the table finally arrived, I discovered that one of the legs had been damaged. I have attached photos of the damage. I have called your customer service three times, but my calls have not been returned.

I would like the table to be replaced as soon as possible. Alternatively, I expect a full refund. I also believe that some compensation should be offered for the inconvenience.

I look forward to receiving your reply within seven days.

Yours faithfully,
Zeynep Kılıç

questions.prompt: What was wrong with the table?
options: One of the legs had been damaged.
questions.explanation: "one of the legs had been damaged"

options: A discount on her next order
A replacement or a full refund
questions.explanation: "I would like the table to be replaced... Alternatively, I expect a full refund."

learn.explanation:
**Resmî şikâyet e-postasının yapısı:**

| Bölüm | Kalıplar |
|---|---|
| **Selamlama** | Dear Sir or Madam, (isim bilinmiyorsa) / Dear Mr / Ms ..., |
| **Amaç** | I am writing to **complain about** ... / to **express my dissatisfaction with** ... |
| **Olay** | On [date], I ordered / bought ... / I **was told** that ... / I **was promised** ... |
| **Sorun** | However, ... / Unfortunately, ... / ... **had been damaged** / **was not delivered** |
| **Yapılan girişimler** | I **have contacted** ... / My calls **have not been returned**. |
| **Talep** | I would like ... **to be replaced / refunded** / I expect a full refund. |
| **Kapanış** | I look forward to receiving your reply. / Yours **faithfully**, (Dear Sir or Madam ile) / Yours **sincerely**, (isimle) |

**Passive neden etkili?**

- Daha **resmî ve tarafsız** bir ton verir.
- Suçlamayı **kişiselleştirmeden** sorunu ortaya koyar: *The table **was damaged*** (siz zarar verdiniz demek yerine).
- **I was told / I was promised** → verilen sözleri hatırlatır.

**Dikkat:**

- Kısaltma kullanmayın: I am (~~I'm~~), was not (~~wasn't~~).
- Öfkeli değil, **kararlı ve net** olun.

examples.tr: Sorunun 24 saat içinde çözüleceğine dair söz verildi.

I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with your service.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçe şikâyet yazılarında bazen duygusal ve uzun cümleler kullanılır. İngilizce resmî yazılarda kısa, net ve olgulara dayalı cümleler daha etkilidir. "Yours faithfully" (alıcının adını bilmiyorsanız) ile "Yours sincerely" (adını biliyorsanız) arasındaki farka dikkat edin.

task.modelAnswer:
Subject: Complaint about phone repair (Ref. 2291)

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about the repair service I received at your branch in Kadıköy.

On 2 May, I left my phone at your shop because the screen had been cracked. I was told that it would be repaired within three working days. However, I was not contacted until 17 May, two weeks later than promised.

When I collected the phone, I was assured that it had been fully tested. Unfortunately, the touch screen stopped working the same evening. I have returned to the shop twice since then, but the problem has still not been solved, and I have been asked to wait another week.

I have been a loyal customer of your company for five years, and I am extremely disappointed. I would like my phone to be repaired properly within the next three days, or replaced with a new one. I also believe that the repair fee should be refunded.

I have attached a copy of my receipt. I look forward to receiving your reply.

Yours faithfully,
Emre Yüksel

questions.modelAnswer:
Dear Mr Aksoy,

I am writing about several problems in the flat, which I moved into on 1 September.

Firstly, the kitchen tap had not been repaired before I arrived, even though I was told it would be fixed. It is still leaking, and the cupboard underneath has been damaged by the water. Secondly, the heating has not been working properly since last week. I have had an electrician check the system, and he says the boiler needs to be replaced.

In addition, the bedroom window cannot be closed completely, so the room gets very cold at night. I have also noticed that the walls in the bathroom have not been painted for a long time.

I had the tap temporarily fixed by a plumber last Friday, and I paid 800 lira for the visit. I have attached the receipt, and I would be grateful if this amount could be refunded.

I would appreciate it if the boiler and the window could be repaired as soon as possible, ideally before the end of this month.

Thank you for your help. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Deniz Akın
